test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

While persimmons can be / use in pies and tarts, you / can also enjoy them plain.

options.text: use in pies and tarts, you

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** error in** the sentence lies in the segment **"use in pies and tarts, you."**
 
• The verb form should be **"used"** instead of **"use"** to align with **"can be."**
 
• The corrected part of the sentence should be **"used in pies and tarts."**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"While persimmons can be **used in pies and tarts,** you can also enjoy them plain." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"While persimmons can be" is grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 4:** "can also enjoy them plain" is grammatically correct.
